name: Leela's Awakening
source: Leela suffers from an amnesia after spending 3 weeks in a coma after a car accident. Her husband Zach fully supports her, but neither of them have any idea that Leela spent the last few years secretly working as a whore and recently has stolen a large sum of money from the mob.
translation: 莉拉在一场车祸后昏迷了三个星期，之后患上了失忆症。她的丈夫扎克全力支持她，但他们都不知道莉拉在过去几年里秘密当妓女，最近又从暴徒那里偷了一大笔钱。
